I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 86-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their fourth dose of DemoZanix (dose: 50mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-28.
Approximately 3 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
